profile.headline: SWE @ Google | Minerva University CS ’22
profile.summary: Minerva University class of 2022. Computer Science major with an interest in philosophy, effective altruism, and social entrepreneurship.

positions.title: Technical Mentor
positions.description: Technical mentor for Technical Interview Prep course

positions.title: Rewriting The Code Fellow
positions.description: Selected as a fellow for Rewriting the Code, a program for undergraduates and masters level students pursuing a degree in computer science and engineering. Joining a strong community of women interested in tech and related opportunities.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Design, develop and test a REST API to implement new features (e.g. version control)
- Create and maintain new front-end functionalities for the company’s web app

Tech stack: JavaScript, Node.js, Vue.js, Express.js, MongoDB.

positions.title: Head of Hackers Outreach
positions.description:
Attracted 500 sign-ups in 1 month for Minerva Hackathon
Acted as communication contact point with hackers

positions.title: Student Experience (SXP) Intern
positions.description:
- Develop system to track and evaluate program impact 
- Support students driven initiatives for 160+ students at Minerva Schools at KGI
- Handle external communications about co-curricular with students at Minerva Schools at KGI

positions.title: Tech Recruiting Assistant
positions.description:
- Shortlisted 300+ candidates and scheduled interviews 
- Managed candidate database (1000+ applicants)
- Created content for company recruitment

educations.schoolName: School of Global Studies, Thammasat University

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Project Incubator for Young Social Entrepreneurs (PISE)

company.name: Project Incubator for Young Social Entrepreneurs (PISE)

volunteerExperiences.description:
Summer Project Committee
Sep 2018 – Jul 2019
- Developed system to support and mentor project proposal application
- Evaluated 10 project proposals for SEALNet Summer Projects in 2019
---------------------------------------------------------------
Project Leader of SEALNet Project Indonesia 2018
Sep 2017 – Aug 2018
- Key tasks: proposal writing, strategic planning, program management, recruited 30 members and worked with 100+ beneficiaries
- Accomplishment: supported team to raise 11,000 USD, first SEALNet project in the border area in Indonesia
---------------------------------------------------------------
Head of Fundraising of SEALNet Project Cambodia 2017
Feb 2017 – Nov 2017
Key tasks: managed fundraising campaign (donations and through events), supported 15 team members to raise 10,000 USD, assisted project leaders in recruitment and emergency
---------------------------------------------------------------
Co-Vice President of SEALNet Vietnam Club
May 2015 – May 2017
- Managed all fund-raising campaigns. Raised $550. Increased the annual’s fund by 200%.
- Built database of over 50 potential sponsors for future uses.
- Handled all external affairs’ communications.
